title: my-crm-agent
description: AI-powered Dynamics 365 CRM Agent with 12 MCP tools and 8 agentic skills. Covers full data lifecycle: natural-language CRM querying, PII detection/masking, daily customer data extraction with sentiment analysis, pain points extraction, and cross-environment data migration with topological dependency resolution. Uses PostgreSQL for historical data and Airflow for orchestration.

title: my-dba-agent
description: AI-powered Database Administration Agent for PostgreSQL with automated PII detection across database tables, statistical confidence scoring, data masking with obfuscation and synthetic replacement strategies, and SQL lineage analysis.

title: core-conversational-agent
description: Agentic core-banking POC featuring an MCP server that wraps a mocked Fiserv DNA with the Intent → Adjudicator → Execute pattern. Demonstrates bounded AI: the LLM produces typed Intents, a deterministic Pydantic Adjudicator validates them, and only approved Commands reach the core.

title: dataverse-to-adls-sync
description: Incremental synchronization from Dataverse to Azure Data Lake Storage using Synapse Link and serverless SQL. Handles large-volume CRM data extraction with watermarking, schema mapping, and delta tracking.

title: dna-to-crm-inhouse
description: Azure Functions app that bridges legacy SSIS-based CSV-to-CRM data loads with the modern Dataverse Web API UpsertMultiple action. Enables high-throughput bulk upserts using alternate keys without GUID pre-resolution.

title: central-mcp-lib
description: Central MCP server library with attach/detach slash commands. Houses canonical copies of MCP servers (fiserv-dna, crmagent, dba) activated per project via directory junctions, standardizing the tool surface across all agent projects.

title: agent-relay
description: Durable, auditable agent-to-agent request channel for AI agents. Implements store-and-poll inbox, A2A-compatible wire format, Teams + OS notifications, and human-in-the-loop approval with hash-chained audit. Built with FastAPI on Azure Container Apps.

title: my-job-agent
description: AI-powered job search and application agent. Automates job discovery, resume tailoring, and application submission using browser automation and LLM agents.
